summary: Seven round-0-label-disjoint held-out TS validation structures were prepared and passed geometry review: six primary rising/near-saddle/falling structures plus one diagnostic failure-boundary interpolation; no calculation was submitted.

payload.objective: Review the seven prepared held-out geometries, then prepare their hash-bound dual-model/VASP validation package only after acceptance.
current_evidence: Seven held-out candidates have unique exact and rounded-geometry hashes with zero overlap against the seven completed round-0 VASP screening labels.
The six primary held-out structures comprise two rising, two near-saddle, and two falling structures with O-H distances 2.829, 2.456, 2.070, 1.683, 1.093, and 1.008 A.
A seventh O-H 1.126 A pre_12/fail_12 midpoint is retained only as a failure-boundary diagnostic and is excluded from primary aggregate validation metrics because its two parents were already labeled.
All candidates preserve 50 atoms, Fe45-C2-O-H2 ordering, the 18-atom fixed layer, cell and Selective Dynamics flags, C-C/C-O/spectator C-H connectivity, and minimum nonbonded-contact gates.
The independent structure-sanity audit returned pass for all seven candidates. No GPU, VASP, fine-tuning, path-rerun, micro-NEB, or Dimer job was submitted.
MatRIS remains retained but not held-out validated; without a real calibrated MatRIS committee, no quantitative uncertainty claim is allowed.
payload.one_executable_step: Obtain user geometry acceptance. If accepted, prepare exact frozen-checkpoint prediction for the new boundary interpolation and a compatible SIGMA=0.20 eV NSW=0 seven-structure VASP validation package; do not submit either package without separate authorization.
payload.submission_boundary: Preparation and review only. GPU prediction, VASP labels, MatRIS fine-tuning, complete-path rerun, micro-NEB, Dimer, TS, and barrier submissions remain unauthorized.
done_when: The user accepts or revises the seven held-out structures.
For accepted structures, all required frozen-checkpoint predictions are hash-bound and the compatible VASP validation batch is prepared for review.
No calibrated-uncertainty or accepted-TS claim is made before independent VASP validation and downstream TS gates pass.
